courses.title: Level 3 Practitioner Physical Intervention
courses.short: A blended Level 3 practitioner programme — two online theory modules plus a face-to-face practical day covering safe, lawful de-escalation and holds. Suitable for children's and adult services.
courses.duration: 3–4 hours online · plus a face-to-face practical day arranged with LSN
courses.modules: Module 1: Prevention, Proactive Care and De-escalation · Module 2: Legal Framework, Safe Practice and Accountability
courses.learning: 14 hours of learning (supports staff CPD records)

courses.title: Safeguarding Children
courses.short: Core safeguarding training for people working with children and young people — recognising risk, thresholds, referral pathways and professional responsibility.
courses.whoFor: Children's homes, foster carers, schools, youth-facing services

courses.title: Adult Safeguarding
courses.short: Safeguarding training for adult social care — recognising abuse and neglect, Mental Capacity Act awareness, DoLS overview and safer practice.
courses.whoFor: Adult social care, supported living, care agencies

courses.title: Trauma-Informed Care
courses.short: Understand how trauma, previous experiences and unmet needs can influence behaviour — and how staff can respond with more thoughtful, effective care.
courses.whoFor: Residential childcare, therapeutic services, foster carers, care teams

courses.title: Positive Behaviour Support
courses.short: Person-centred approaches to understanding behaviour, communication, individual needs and least restrictive practice.
courses.whoFor: Supported living, learning disability services, adult social care

courses.title: Registered Manager & Leadership Development
courses.short: Advanced professional development for people leading regulated care services — safeguarding oversight, workforce, quality assurance and inspection readiness.
courses.whoFor: Registered Managers, Deputy Managers, Responsible Individuals
